name: czl-xhs-note-workshop
description: A Xiaohongshu note production line, not an account consultant. It takes whatever raw material the user has - product info, a personal experience, store photos, a course outline, a competitor screenshot - and runs it through seven stations: intake, positioning, topic matrix, drafting, a two-gate quality check, scheduling, and post-publish diagnosis. Every note leaves as a note card carrying five title candidates, a three-line cover spec, a copyable body, a first-comment hook and a 3+3+2 tag set. Two hard gates sit before anything ships: a compliance gate (absolute claims, medical efficacy, off-platform diversion, fabricated first-hand experience, AI-content labeling) and a human-voice gate (twelve Chinese AI-writing tells). Works fully offline through three pure-stdlib scripts - note_lint.py scores a note against 40+ machine-checkable rules, build_calendar.py turns approved notes into a 7/14/30-day schedule, selftest.py reproduces the whole chain end to end. No MCP, no login, no browser automation required. Use for 小红书起号, 笔记代写, 选题库, 标题封面优化, 日更排期, 笔记数据复盘.

displayDescription.en: Turns scattered material into angles, ships publish-ready Xiaohongshu notes through a compliance gate and a human-voice gate, plus a posting calendar and a diagnosis sheet.
displayDescription.zh: 把零散素材切成角度，产出可直接发布的小红书笔记，过合规与人味两道闸，附发布日历与复盘诊断。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我手上有一款护手霜和二十几条用户反馈，想在小红书起号。帮我把这些素材切成选题，先写 5 篇能直接发的笔记。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a hand cream and twenty-odd pieces of user feedback, and I want to start a Xiaohongshu account. Turn this material into topics and draft 5 notes I can publish as-is.

quickPrompts.en: I have a hand cream and twenty-odd pieces of user feedback, and I want to start a Xiaohongshu account. Turn this material into topics and draft 5 notes I can publish as-is.

quickPrompts.zh: 上一篇笔记曝光 3000、点击 120、点赞 9。封面和标题都在这里，帮我判断问题出在哪一级，下次改什么。
quickPrompts.en: My last note got 3,000 impressions, 120 clicks and 9 likes. Here's the cover and title - tell me which stage broke and what to change next time.

quickPrompts.zh: 我一个人做账号，每周只能出 3 篇。帮我排一个 30 天的小红书发布日历，素材要能反复用。
quickPrompts.en: I run the account alone and can only ship 3 notes a week. Build me a 30-day Xiaohongshu calendar that reuses material.
